newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai interbank rate lower, baht weakens late.
newsitem.headline: Thai interbank rate lower, baht weakens late.

text.p: The Thai overnight interbank rate dipped to 9.00-9.25 percent in late trade on Wednesday from 10.50 percent early as liquidity continued to rise, dealers said.
Dealers said the higher money supply was boosted by imports of cheap foreign funds following the decline in dollar/baht swap premiums.
"Most banks have an excess of funds after the daily check clearing. The major lenders were also sidelined," said one dealer at a major local bank.
The baht weakened to 25.489-25.494 to the dollar late from 25.480-25.483 early on the dollar's strength abroad, dealers said.
"The trade was very thin today. Most players were reluctant to take positions ahead of the holiday in the New York market tomorrow," one currency dealer said.
The one-month dollar/baht swap premium was lower to 8.20/8.90 satangs per a dollar late against 9.00 in the morning.
The Bank of Thailand fixed the dollar/baht mid-rate at 25.48 against 25.46 on Tuesday. -- Anuchit Nguyen (662) 652-0642
